  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_affine_stress(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive: tuple[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], ...] = (), current_tolerance: float = 0.004, archive_tolerance: float = 0.045, min_span_fraction: float = 0.55) -> tuple[float, float, bool]:
    """Return gain, physical bias, and whether the gain came from the archive.

    Supply one instrument's checks, in common stress units, and any applicable
    archived sweeps oldest first. Residual tolerances and minimum command span
    are fractions of stress_scale. Fit by clipped-residual pair consensus and
    inlier refitting, without a gain ridge. A supported current sweep takes
    precedence; short sweeps cannot override an archive gain. Only matching
    current checks update transferred bias. Without checks that distinguish
    archive sweeps, the most recent applicable sweep is the default prior.
    """
    knobs = np.array([stress_scale, current_tolerance, archive_tolerance, min_span_fraction])
    if not np.isfinite(knobs).all() or np.any(knobs <= 0):
        raise ValueError('stress scale, tolerances and span must be positive')

    def clean(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
        if a.ndim != 1 or b.shape != a.shape:
            raise ValueError('checks must be matching vectors')
        keep = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        return a[keep] / stress_scale, b[keep] / stress_scale

    def sweep(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, tol: float, minimum: int) -> np.ndarray | None:
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        best, best_cost = None, np.inf
        for a, b in zip(i, j):
            dx = x[b] - x[a]
            if abs(dx) < 4 * tol:
                continue
            gain = (y[b] - y[a]) / dx
            if gain <= 0:
                continue
            ok = abs(y - (y[a] + gain * (x - x[a]))) < tol
            if ok.sum() < minimum or np.ptp(x[ok]) < min_span_fraction:
                continue
            line = np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[x[ok], np.ones(ok.sum())], y[ok], rcond=None)[0]
            if line[0] <= 0:
                continue
            r = abs(y - line[0] * x - line[1]) / tol
            ok = r < 1
            if ok.sum() < minimum or np.ptp(x[ok]) < min_span_fraction:
                continue
            cost = np.sum(np.minimum(r, 1)**2)
            if cost < best_cost:
                best, best_cost = line, cost
        return best

    x, y = clean(command, measured)
    line = sweep(x, y, current_tolerance, 4)
    if line is not None:
        return float(line[0]), float(line[1] * stress_scale), False
    local = sweep(x, y, current_tolerance, 3)
    priors = [p for a, b in archive if (p := sweep(*clean(a, b), archive_tolerance, 3)) is not None]
    if priors:
        p = np.asarray(priors)
        delta = y[None, :] - p[:, 0, None] * x - p[:, 1, None]
        r = abs(delta) / current_tolerance
        match = r < 1
        index = np.lexsort((-np.arange(len(p)), np.sum(np.minimum(r, 1)**2, axis=1), -match.sum(axis=1)))[0]
        good = match[index]
        if good.sum() >= (1 if local is None else 2):
            return float(p[index, 0]), float((p[index, 1] + np.median(delta[index, good])) * stress_scale), True
        if local is None:
            return float(p[-1, 0]), float(p[-1, 1] * stress_scale), True
    if local is not None:
        return float(local[0]), float(local[1] * stress_scale), False
    raise ValueError('no current or archive sweep supports an affine calibration')


def align_reference_features(features: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned/imputed features and a mask of originally incomplete rows.

    Reference and feature matrices share row labels. Reference columns measure
    the same group-wise affine nuisance as features and have comparable baseline
    moments across groups. Use medians of column means and population standard
    deviations over reference columns with at least two finite entries. Average
    the observed group–stratum cell means equally, per feature, with no shrinkage;
    a wholly missing feature receives zero. Pass permitted unlabeled cohorts together.
    """
    x, ref = np.asarray(features, float).copy(), np.asarray(reference, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not len(x) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, references and labels must share a nonempty row axis')
    gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    finite = np.isfinite(x)
    for k in np.unique(gi):
        rows = gi == k
        r = np.where(np.isfinite(ref[rows]), ref[rows], np.nan)
        keep = np.isfinite(r).sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not keep.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no supported reference column')
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(r[:, keep], axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(r[:, keep], axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(center) or not np.isfinite(spread) or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('group requires a finite reference center and positive spread')
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / spread
    cell = np.unique(np.c_[gi, si], axis=0, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    total, support = np.zeros(x.shape[1]), np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    for k in np.unique(cell):
        rows = cell == k
        ok = finite[rows]
        n = ok.sum(axis=0)
        total += np.divide(np.where(ok, x[rows], 0).sum(axis=0), n, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=n > 0)
        support += n > 0
    fill = np.divide(total, support, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=support > 0)
    return np.where(finite, x, fill), ~finite.all(axis=1)


def fit_thresholded_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, past_duration: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, strain0: np.ndarray, strain_obs: np.ndarray, rate_obs: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, groups: np.ndarray | None = None, incomplete: np.ndarray | None = None, prediction_rate: np.ndarray | None = None, rank_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit ordered taus, hereditary weights, plastic weights, curves and initial rates.

    Start with zero memory; past stress is piecewise constant, oldest first,
    with one shared duration per segment. Inputs are calibrated stresses and
    finite aligned features. Curve observations are absolute strains; rates
    are strain per input time unit. Mark prediction-only rows with nonfinite
    training observations. A separate prediction_rate is never used for fitting.
    The hereditary weights are two compliances, drift intercept, feature slopes;
    plastic weights are signed hold overstress and history work times hold.

    Profiles bounded log times using Cauchy IRLS (cutoff 3 MAD units, five
    passes), with no coefficient ridge and a weighted, column-scaled rank gate.
    Prefer complete coupons when they identify all observed terms. On prediction
    rows, finite rate innovations update only drift: unit gain on incomplete
    rows, otherwise a supported leave-one-group-out gain in [0, 1] or zero.
    """
    past, hold, dt, t, x, e0, obs, rate = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (past_stress, hold_stress, past_duration, times, features, strain0, strain_obs, rate_obs))
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if not (np.isfinite([lo, hi, yield_stress]).all() and 0 < lo < hi and yield_stress > 0 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1):
        raise ValueError('invalid relaxation bounds, yield stress or rank tolerance')
    if past.ndim != 2 or dt.shape != (past.shape[1],) or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size:
        raise ValueError('expected piecewise-constant histories and a time vector')
    n = len(past)
    if hold.shape != (n,) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or e0.shape != (n,) or obs.shape != (n, t.size) or rate.shape != (n,):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent feature, stress or observation dimensions')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (past, hold, dt, t, x, e0)) or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0) or t.max() <= 0:
        raise ValueError('finite inputs, nonnegative durations and a positive horizon required')
    missing = np.zeros(n, bool) if incomplete is None else np.asarray(incomplete, bool)
    group = None if groups is None else np.asarray(groups)
    proxy = None if prediction_rate is None else np.asarray(prediction_rate, float)
    if missing.shape != (n,) or any(a is not None and a.shape != (n,) for a in (group, proxy)):
        raise ValueError('incomplete mask, groups and prediction rates must match rows')

    S = yield_stress
    T = np.exp((np.log(lo) + np.log(hi)) / 2)
    low, high = np.log(np.array([lo, hi]) / T)
    past, hold, dt, t = past / S, hold / S, dt / T, t / T
    end = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if dt.size else dt
    ov = np.sign(hold) * np.maximum(abs(hold) - 1, 0)**2
    work = (np.maximum(abs(past) - 1, 0)**2 @ dt) * hold
    drift = np.c_[np.ones(n), x, ov]
    p = 2 + drift.shape[1] + 1
    raw = np.c_[obs - e0[:, None], rate * T]
    seen = np.isfinite(raw)
    train = seen.any(axis=1)
    informative = (seen[:, :-1] & (t > 0)).any(axis=1) | seen[:, -1]
    plastic = np.c_[ov, work] != 0
    active_plastic = plastic[informative].any(axis=0)
    if np.any(plastic.any(axis=0) & ~active_plastic):
        raise ValueError('a requested plastic term has no observed excitation')

    def design(log_tau: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        tau = np.exp(log_tau)
        mix = np.exp(-end[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
        delta = hold[:, None] - past @ mix
        response = -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)
        curve = np.concatenate((delta[:, None, :] * response[None, :, :], drift[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None], (work[:, None] * response[:, 0])[:, :, None]), axis=2)
        initial = np.c_[delta / tau, drift, work / tau[0]]
        return np.concatenate((curve, initial[:, None, :]), axis=1)

    def ordered(z: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([z[0], z[0] + (high - z[0]) * z[1]])

    def mad(v: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(1.4826 * np.median(abs(v - np.median(v)))) if v.size else 0.

    def solve(rows: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        if np.any(active_plastic & ~plastic[rows & informative].any(axis=0)):
            raise ValueError('fit subset lacks plastic excitation')
        mask = seen & rows[:, None]
        active = np.r_[np.ones(p - 2, bool), active_plastic]
        if mask.sum() < active.sum() + 2 or not (mask[:, :-1] & (t > 0)).any():
            raise ValueError('insufficient observations to identify creep parameters')
        y = raw[mask]
        norm = np.median(abs(y)) or np.max(abs(y))
        if norm == 0:
            raise ValueError('zero response cannot identify relaxation times')
        y = y / norm
        is_rate = np.nonzero(mask)[1] == t.size
        weight = np.where(is_rate, 1 / 1.5, 1.)

        def profile(z: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
            A = design(ordered(z))[mask][:, active]
            coef = np.linalg.lstsq(A * weight[:, None], y * weight, rcond=None)[0]
            return coef, A @ coef - y, A

        def optimize(z: np.ndarray):
            return least_squares(lambda v: weight * profile(v)[1], z, bounds=([low, 0.], [high, 1.]), max_nfev=160)

        pilots = [optimize(np.array([low + (high - low) * a, (b - a) / (1 - a)]))
                  for a, b in ((0.15, 0.45), (0.30, 0.65), (0.50, 0.85), (0.12, 0.88))]
        good = [fit for fit in pilots if fit.success]
        if not good:
            raise RuntimeError('profiled creep pilot did not converge')
        z = min(good, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x
        r = profile(z)[1]
        cs = max(mad(r[~is_rate]), 1e-8)
        rs = max(mad(r[is_rate]), cs / 4)
        base = 1 / np.where(is_rate, rs, cs)
        for _ in range(5):
            weight = base / np.hypot(1, base * r / 3)
            fit = optimize(z)
            if not fit.success:
                raise RuntimeError('reweighted creep fit did not converge')
            z = fit.x
            coef, r, A = profile(z)

        logs = ordered(z)
        step = 1e-5
        derivatives = []
        for h in np.eye(2) * step:
            D = ((design(logs + h) - design(logs - h))[mask][:, active]) / (2 * step)
            derivatives.append(D @ coef)
        J = np.column_stack((*derivatives, A)) * (base / np.hypot(1, base * r / 3))[:, None]
        lengths = np.linalg.norm(J, axis=0)
        if logs[1] <= logs[0] or np.any(lengths <= np.finfo(float).eps * lengths.max()):
            raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
        sv = np.linalg.svd(J / lengths, compute_uv=False)
        if sv[-1] < rank_rtol * sv[0]:
            raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
        beta = np.zeros(p)
        beta[active] = coef * norm
        return logs, beta

    complete = train & ~missing
    if np.any(train & missing):
        try:
            logs, beta = solve(complete)
        except (ValueError, RuntimeError):
            logs, beta = solve(train)
    else:
        logs, beta = solve(train)
    pred = design(logs) @ beta
    if proxy is not None:
        use = ~train & np.isfinite(proxy)
        gain = missing.astype(float)
        if group is not None:
            for label in np.unique(group[use & ~missing]):
                held = complete & (group == label) & seen[:, -1] & (seen[:, :-1] & (t > 0)).any(axis=1)
                if held.sum() < p:
                    continue
                try:
                    held_logs, held_beta = solve(complete & (group != label))
                except (ValueError, RuntimeError):
                    continue
                error = (raw - design(held_logs) @ held_beta)[held]
                positive = t > 0
                curve = error[:, :-1][:, positive] / t[positive]
                apparent = np.nanmedian(np.where(np.isfinite(curve), curve, np.nan), axis=1)
                innovation = error[:, -1]
                if not np.any(innovation):
                    continue
                floor = 1e-8 * max(np.max(abs(innovation)), np.max(abs(apparent)))
                scale = max(mad(apparent - innovation), floor)
                k = least_squares(lambda v: (v[0] * innovation - apparent) / scale, [0.25], bounds=(0., 1.), loss='soft_l1').x[0]
                gain[(group == label) & ~missing] = k
        adjustment = gain[use] * (proxy[use] * T - pred[use, -1])
        pred[use] += adjustment[:, None] * np.r_[t, 1.]

    hereditary = beta[:-2] / np.r_[S, S, np.full(x.shape[1] + 1, T)]
    viscoplastic = beta[-2:] / np.array([S**2 * T, S**3 * T])
    return np.exp(logs) * T, hereditary, viscoplastic, pred[:, :-1] + e0[:, None], pred[:, -1] / T

def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2.])

    np.testing.assert_allclose(ap, aligned[perm], atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(mp, missing[perm])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(52)

    dt = np.array([0.25, 0.65, 1.2])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.06, 9., 24)]
    tau = np.array([0.43, 2.7])

        hold = rng.uniform(-peak, peak, n)

            memory = decay * memory + (1 - decay) * past[:, j, None]

        amplitude[:, 0] += wp[1] * work * hold
        drift = h[2] + x @ h[3:] + wp[0] * np.sign(hold) * np.maximum(abs(hold) - sy, 0)**2
        truth = e0[:, None] + amplitude @ (1 - np.exp(-t[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * t
        rate = amplitude @ (1 / tau) + drift
        obs, measured = truth.copy(), rate.copy()
        if above:
            obs[[0, 2, 5, 8, 13, 19], [3, 5, 8, 2, 16, 11]] += [0.3, -0.4, 0.3, 0.5, -0.3, -0.4]
            measured[15] -= 0.3
        obs[-4:], measured[-4:] = np.nan, np.nan
        args = (past, hold, dt, t, x, e0, obs, measured, sy, bounds)
        fitted = fit_thresholded_creep(*args)

        np.testing.assert_allclose(fitted[0], tau, rtol=0.02)

        if not above:

        np.testing.assert_allclose(fitted[4][-4:], rate[-4:], atol=2e-4)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(fitted[3][:, 0], e0, atol=1e-14)

        np.testing.assert_allclose(corrected[3][-4:] - fitted[3][-4:], np.r_[0.018, 0., 0., 0.][:, None] * t, atol=2e-8)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(corrected[4][-4:] - fitted[4][-4:], [0.018, 0., 0., 0.], atol=2e-8)

    hold = np.clip(hold, -sy, sy)
    hold[-1] = 1.5 * sy
